events.label: Became one of Muhammad's earliest followers
events.labelCn: 成为穆罕默德最早的追随者之一
events.note: Tradition places the young ʿAlī among the very earliest believers.

events.label: Helped Muhammad's departure from Mecca during the Hijra
events.labelCn: 在希吉拉期间协助穆罕默德离开麦加
events.note: Sīra tradition says he stayed temporarily to return entrusted property and later joined Muhammad in Medina.

events.label: Married Fāṭima, daughter of Muhammad
events.labelCn: 与穆罕默德之女法蒂玛结婚
events.note: The marriage produced Ḥasan, Ḥusayn and the principal Alid genealogical lines.

events.label: Distinguished himself at the Battle of Badr
events.labelCn: 在白德尔战役中表现突出
events.note: He was among the prominent Muslim fighters at Badr.

events.label: Fought at Uḥud and remained near Muhammad during the crisis
events.labelCn: 参加伍侯德战役并在危机中保护穆罕默德
events.note: Later traditions emphasize his defensive role after the Muslim formation broke.

events.label: Fought in the Battle of the Trench
events.note: His duel with ʿAmr ibn ʿAbd Wudd is famous but literary details are later.

events.label: Played a leading military role at Khaybar
events.labelCn: 在海拜尔战役中发挥重要军事作用
events.note: Traditions across sectarian lines associate him with a decisive role.

events.label: Participated in the conquest and religious reordering of Mecca
events.labelCn: 参与征服麦加及其宗教秩序重建
events.note: Later reports assign him roles in implementing the new order.

events.label: Was sent on a mission to Yemen
events.labelCn: 受派前往也门执行任务
events.note: Muhammad entrusted him with military, judicial and administrative responsibilities.

events.label: Became central to the disputed succession memory of Ghadīr Khumm
events.labelCn: 成为盖迪尔·胡姆继承记忆争议的核心人物
events.note: The statement concerning ʿAlī is widely transmitted, but Sunni and Shi'i traditions disagree over whether it designated succession.

events.label: Did not become caliph after Muhammad's death
events.labelCn: 穆罕默德去世后未立即成为哈里发
events.note: Abū Bakr was selected at Saqīfa while ʿAlī and the Prophet's household were initially outside that decision.

events.label: Became caliph after the killing of ʿUthmān
events.labelCn: 奥斯曼遇害后成为哈里发
events.note: He received allegiance amid severe fragmentation.

events.label: Defeated ʿĀʾisha, Ṭalḥa and al-Zubayr at the Battle of the Camel
events.labelCn: 在骆驼之战中击败阿伊莎、泰勒哈与祖拜尔联盟
events.note: The victory was the first major battle of the First Fitna.

events.label: Fought Muʿāwiya at Ṣiffīn
events.labelCn: 在隋芬与穆阿维叶交战
events.note: The battle ended inconclusively and led to arbitration.

events.label: Defeated the Khārijites at Nahrawān
events.labelCn: 在纳赫拉万击败哈瓦利吉派
events.note: Former supporters who rejected arbitration broke with him.

events.label: Was assassinated at Kufa and died from his wounds
events.labelCn: 在库法遇刺并因伤去世
events.note: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Muljam struck him with a poisoned sword; he died shortly afterward.

sourceNote: Wilferd Madelung; Hugh Kennedy; Najam Haider; al-Ṭabarī used critically; Encyclopaedia of Islam scholarship; Wikipedia as supplementary chronology index.
notes:
Connects the Prophetic family, Rashidun caliphate and later Alid traditions. His sons by Fāṭima form the two major branches of Muhammad's surviving genealogical descent.

Confidence / caveats: Birth is conventionally c.600 and the Kaʿba-birth tradition is not independently secure. Sunni Islam numbers him fourth caliph from 656; Shi'i traditions regard him as designated first Imam from 632. Ghadīr Khumm is transmitted but its meaning is disputed. Battlefield details are often hagiographically elaborated.

Unlinked family: mother: Fāṭima bint Asad; spouse: Khawla bint Jaʿfar al-Ḥanafiyya; child: Zaynab bint ʿAlī; child: Umm Kulthūm bint ʿAlī; child: Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥanafiyya
